name: Vampiric Burst, Greater
body:
School necromancy; Level arcanist 8, psychic 9, sorcerer 8, witch 8, wizard 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 20 ft.
Area 20-ft.-radius burst centered on you
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fortitude half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This works as vampiric burst, except you create one burst when first casting the spell, and may create additional bursts as a standard action during the spell duration, to a maximum of one burst per six caster levels you have.

Mythic The spell’s damage increases to 1d10 points of damage per 2 caster levels, and the maximum temporary hit points you can gain from this spell increase to 10 per caster level.

Augmented (8th): If you expend two uses of mythic power and the damage kills a creature, you gain fast healing 10 for a number of rounds equal to the Hit Dice of the target. If the spell kills multiple targets, the duration of this fast healing stacks.
